abilities.slagMine: Drop a lump of live slag that bursts when an enemy steps near it: {damage} damage within {radius} m. Up to {maxActive} at once.
abilities.fuse: Hold to fuse a damaged building or frame whole again, {repairMultiplier}x as fast as a Delver's ordinary work.
abilities.lurch: Throw your weight the way you're moving: {speedMultiplier}x speed for {duration} s.
abilities.moltenVolley: Spit {count} gobs of slag in a spread: {damage} damage each.
abilities.slagPot: Lob a pot of slag that bursts after {fuse} s: {damage} damage within {radius} m.
abilities.reforge: Set a badly cracked frame nearby back to {amount%} of its health in one heat.
abilities.anneal: Hold to heat a damaged frame to glowing and let it set whole: {amount} health a second.
abilities.spin: Spin the wheel up: {speedMultiplier}x speed for {duration} s.
abilities.survey: Ring the ground and listen to it come back: see everything within {radius} m for {duration} s, through the fog.
abilities.overrun: Roll straight through them: {damage} damage and a {knockback} m shove to whatever you hit.
abilities.topple: Lean in and fall forward: {damage} damage and a {knockback} m shove to whatever you hit.
abilities.quake: Bring both fists down: {damage} damage within {radius} m, and they move at {slowMultiplier%} speed for {slowDuration} s.
abilities.braceStone: Lock every column in place: absorbs {absorb} damage for {duration} s.
abilities.setLegs: Plant the four legs. While set, you deal {damageMultiplier}x damage at {rangeMultiplier}x range, but you can't walk.
abilities.spatter: Fling the crucible's dregs: {count} splashes of {damage} damage, spread over {distance} m.
abilities.attract: Throw a pulse that drags enemies within {radius} m of where it lands {distance} m toward its middle, slowed to {slowMultiplier%} for {slowDuration} s.
abilities.repel: Flip the field: {damage} damage to everything within {radius} m, shoved {knockback} m away.
abilities.raiseColumns: Call a row of columns up out of the ground, {width} m wide, for {duration} s. Shots stop at them; so does everyone.
abilities.quench: Pour off the heat: every frame of yours within {radius} m drops to no heat at once and mends {amount%} of its health.
abilities.pour: Tip the ladle: a pool of molten ore {radius} m across where it lands, burning anything standing in it for {damage} damage a second, for {duration} s.
abilities.shadowstep: Step {distance} m along your own shadow.
abilities.noonMark: Mark a target in noon light: for {duration} s it takes {damageMultiplier}x damage from everything, and every ally sees it.
abilities.meridianLine: Your next shot runs straight through everything in a line, at {damageMultiplier}x damage.
abilities.vent: Dump this frame's heat as a ring of slag around you. Everything near you is burned and staggered; you are too, for a moment.

units.delver: Digs ore and stacks columns into buildings. Also strips wrecks for ore: anything armored that dies leaves one for a while.
units.hewn: The Engines' line soldier: a stocky frame that throws slag. Slower than a Trooper, but it takes a beating.
units.annealer: Mends frames: heats the cracks closed. Repairs Engine units the way a Medic heals soldiers.
units.spindle: A fast scout that rolls on one great wheel. Slow to get going, hard to stop.
units.cairn: A walking pile of columns that fights with its fists. Tough, slow, and very bad for buildings.
units.crucible: Artillery: lobs molten ore a long way. Can't hit anything too close.
units.lodestone: Throws a field that grounds the link: no enemy can possess anything near it, and a possessed enemy is thrown out.
units.ashlar: The Mason, a front-line hero. Swings a whole column, raises walls of columns out of the ground, and makes allies near it harder to hurt.
units.cupel: The Refiner, a support hero. Lobs molten ore, pours burning pools, and quenches the heat out of every frame around it. Allies near it fire faster.
units.gnomon: The Long Shadow, a marksman hero. The longest reach of any frame; its shots can run straight through a line of enemies.

buildings.lodehearth: The Engines' heart: a pit of molten ore where cores condense. Makes Delvers and takes the ore they bring. Lose every one and you lose the match.
buildings.kiln: Fires Hewn and Annealers out of ore.
buildings.foundry: Casts Spindles, Cairns, Crucibles and Lodestones.
buildings.obelisk: A defense column that lobs slag at enemies in range.
buildings.coreVault: Wakes great cores: your heroes. Only one burns at a time; wake another and the old one sleeps, and its frame falls in.
